title: 第126章 邝楠黎的病第125章 替绮梦修复她的族人
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
“小姐，他说的蚩雷诡符阵，老奴根本没听过，会不会......”
绮梦有些心神不安地盯着地面，“我现在还有选择吗？家里人都那样了，我们已经没任何选择。老广，他们是不是要到了？”
老广躬身道：“青狗宗的人马上就到了，小姐，在这里解决他们，依靠手里这点人，恐怕不够。”
“把所有能用的都拿出去，再招募人手，这次劫难躲不过去，我们都得死。”
“小姐，但有一物乃是小姐老祖留下，此物不可卖。以老奴之见，前辈若真能救，此物不妨送给前辈，如此一来，小姐亦可脱身。”
绮梦抓起柜子上的一把梳子，“此物制作也算精良，放店里能卖多少？”
“小姐，仅仅如此普通，也就卖五钱银子，若是炼化一番，品质不差，可卖出七两左右银子，再贵一些也就十两上下。”
绮梦换了一把梳子，此乃玉制而成，还特意炼化一番，但品质太差。
“那位前辈非一般人，我找人算过，此次危机若能渡过，关键还在那位前辈，但此物......老广，此事不得再提。赶紧去办事吧。明天是最关键的一天，让所有人都提高警惕。鱼市查的如何？”
“小姐，鱼市的事情倒是有些眉目......这不是邝小姐吗，怎么这么晚还来此地？”
老广看到熟人来就先去应付着。
“上次你卖给我的那把梳子品质倒是不错，明日我还要出去拜访姐妹，不知还有没有？”
绮梦装作客人挑着梳子。
“邝小姐，那把梳子也是很难炼化而成，若是差一点，小人倒是有，不过那么好的品质小人实在没有了。”
邝楠黎瞥了一眼女扮男装的绮梦，原本想离开了，忽然有了心思。
“这位公子是否遇见过一位前辈？”
“前辈？哪一位前辈？”
绮梦怕被人认出，还是用男声。
“是一位......”
邝楠黎将那位前辈的样貌说的清清楚楚。

“你为何认识那位前辈？”
“小女子乃是九里十八铺的人，加入不过数日，但我家也算是前辈的门下弟子。前辈给九里十八铺一大批灵石和宝物，小女子家受前辈恩惠，没想竟在此地见到。”
绮梦顿时心下好奇，“你看到我如何知道前辈？莫不是我身上有前辈的禁制？”
“正是，前辈给九里十八铺也有禁制灵符，我家族也分得数张，故而能认得姑娘身上的禁制。”
老广意识有事，赶紧离开柜台去门口守着。
绮梦放下梳子，上下打量了一番，“你一个大小姐，为何来此地买梳子？”
“小姐，请坐。”
邝楠黎丫鬟搬来了椅子。
“我家得到前辈恩惠前，这里的梳子哪怕最贱的，我都要想一番这才下决心。现在家里情况好一些，但这里的梳子还是最好。”
“既然你识破我身份，那我也有事求你，我需要一些人手。我手里还有一些财物，还能换百万上品左右。”
邝楠黎感到胸口不适，让丫鬟拿出丹药，“我这身体多亏爹爹倾尽家产，原本爹爹还想带我去找前辈，没想这么巧。”
丫鬟倒了一粒跌落过去，“小姐，这药快没了，要赶紧回家了。”
“你这是从娘胎里带回来的，那位前辈未必能救，但也有可能，前辈正在闭关，明日下午或能出关。”
邝楠黎吞下丹药，慢慢调息。
content_en:
"Miss, I have never heard of the Chi Lei Jue Talisman Array he mentioned. Could it be that..."
Qimeng stared at the ground uneasily, "Do I still have a choice now? Everyone in my family is like that, and we have no choice anymore. Lao Guang, are they coming?"
Lao Guang bowed and said: "The people from the Qing Dog Sect will be here soon. Miss, we can deal with them here. I'm afraid it won't be enough to rely on the few people we have."
"Take out everything you can use and recruit more people. This disaster cannot be avoided and we will all die."
"Miss, there is one thing left by my ancestor. This thing cannot be sold. In my opinion, if the senior can really save me, I might as well give this thing to him. In this way, the young lady can escape."
Qimeng grabbed a comb on the cabinet and said, "This thing is well made. How much can it sell for in the store?"
"Miss, it's just so ordinary, it only costs five taels of silver. If it is refined and the quality is not bad, it can be sold for about seven taels of silver. If it is more expensive, it will only cost about ten taels."
Qimeng changed a comb. This one was made of jade and was specially refined, but the quality was too poor.
"That senior is not an ordinary person. I asked someone to do the math. If this crisis can be overcome, the key lies with that senior, but this thing... Lao Guang, this matter must not be mentioned again. Go and do things quickly. Tomorrow is the most critical day, so everyone should be more vigilant. How is the fish market investigation?"
"Miss, there is something interesting about the fish market... Isn't this Miss Kuang? Why are you here so late?"
When Lao Guang saw an acquaintance coming, he went to deal with it first.
"The comb you sold me last time was of good quality. I'm going to visit my sisters tomorrow. Do you still have it?"
Qimeng pretended to be a guest and picked up a comb.
"Ms. Kuang, that comb is also very difficult to refine. If it's even worse, I do have a villain, but I don't have such a good quality villain anymore."
Kuang Nanli glanced at Qimeng, who was disguised as a man. She originally wanted to leave, but suddenly she had an idea.
"Has this young master met a senior?"
"Senior? Which senior?"
Qimeng was afraid of being recognized, so she still used a male voice.
"It's a..."
Kuang Nanli clearly explained the appearance of the senior.
"Why do you know that senior?"
"The little girl is from Jiuli Shibapu. She has only been here for a few days, but my family can be regarded as the disciples of the senior. The senior gave Jiuli Shibapu a large number of spiritual stones and treasures. The little girl's family received the favor from the senior, so I didn't expect to see them here."
Qimeng suddenly became curious, "How do you know about senior when you see me? Could it be that I have senior's restrictions on me?"
"Exactly, the seniors also have forbidden talismans for Jiuli Shibapu, and my family also got several, so we can recognize the forbidden talismans on the girl."
Lao Guang realized something was wrong and quickly left the counter to guard the door.
Qimeng put down the comb and looked it up and down, "You are a young lady, why do you come here to buy a comb?"
"Miss, please sit down."
Kuang Nanli, the maid, brought a chair.
"Before my family got the favor from the elders, even if the combs here were the cheapest, I had to think about it before making up my mind. Now the situation at home is better, but the combs here are still the best."
"Since you have seen through my identity, I have something to ask of you. I need some manpower. I still have some property in my hand, which can be exchanged for about a million high-grade goods."
Kuang Nanli felt chest discomfort and asked the maid to take out the elixir, "I owe my health to my father who spent all his wealth. Originally, my father wanted to take me to find my senior, but it was such a coincidence."
The maid poured one pill and dropped it, "Miss, this medicine is almost gone. You have to go home quickly."
"You were brought back from your mother's womb. The senior may not be able to save you, but it is also possible that the senior is in retreat and may be able to come out tomorrow afternoon."
Kuang Nanli swallowed the elixir and slowly adjusted his breathing.
